en: 50 g wholewheat flour
1 egg
1 tsp oil
Spring onion and green chilli, chopped
Cumin, chilli powder, salt
Knead the flour with water and rest 15 minutes
Roll it thin and cook it on a hot griddle
Beat the egg with the onion, chilli and spices
Pour the egg over the paratha and flip until set
1 cup boiled chickpeas
1 onion and 1 tomato, chopped
1 small boiled potato, cubed
Juice of 1 lemon, chaat masala
Coriander, mint, green chilli
Put the chickpeas and potato in a large bowl
Add the onion, tomato and green chilli
Add the lemon juice, chaat masala and salt
Toss gently and top with coriander and mint
Coarse semolina 40 g
Sugar 15 g and 1 tsp ghee
Saffron strands and ground cardamom
Whole-wheat flour 40 g for the puri dough and 1 tsp oil
Water as needed
Chopped almonds and pistachios 5 g
Knead the wheat flour with the oil and a little water into a firm dough, rest 10 minutes, then roll into small thin discs.
Bake the discs in a 220°C oven on a hot tray for 5-6 minutes, turning once, until they puff slightly and turn golden.
Heat the ghee and toast the semolina over low heat 4-5 minutes until fragrant, then gradually stir in warm water.
Add the sugar, saffron and cardamom and cook until it comes together, top with the nuts and serve with the puri.

name.en: Anda Bhurji (Spiced Scrambled Eggs) with Toast

en: 2 eggs
1 small onion, 1 small tomato and green chilli, chopped
1 slice whole-wheat bread (30 g)
1 tsp oil
Turmeric, red chilli and ground cumin
Salt and fresh coriander
Heat the oil and sauté the onion and green chilli until softened.
Add the tomato, turmeric, red chilli and cumin and cook until the tomato softens.
Beat the eggs with salt and pour them into the pan, stirring constantly until set and crumbly.
Garnish with coriander and serve with toasted bread.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g
Boiled mashed potato 80 g
1 small onion, chopped, and green chilli
Ground cumin, garam masala, amchur and salt
2 tsp oil for cooking
Low-fat yogurt 80 g to serve
Mix the mashed potato with the onion, green chilli, spices and salt.
Knead the flour with water into a soft dough, divide into two balls and roll into discs.
Place the filling between the two discs and press the edges to seal, then roll out gently again.
Cook on a hot griddle, brushing lightly with oil on both sides until golden and crisp, and serve with the yogurt.
Yellow split chickpeas (chana dal), cooked, 120 g
1 small tomato and 1 small onion, chopped
Garlic-ginger paste, turmeric, cumin and garam masala
1 tsp oil
Whole-wheat flour 40 g for the thin pakwaan dough and 1 tsp oil for brushing
Salt, fresh coriander and lemon juice
Mash half the cooked lentils and leave the other half whole.
Heat the oil and sauté the onion until softened, then add the garlic-ginger paste and spices.
Add the tomato, both lentil textures and a little water, and cook 7-8 minutes until it thickens, add salt and lemon juice.
Knead the flour with the oil and a little water, roll into very thin discs, cook on a dry hot griddle until crisp, and serve alongside the daal with coriander.
Cooked chickpeas 150 g
1 piece naan bread (60 g)
Puréed tomato 80 g and 1 medium onion
1 tsp oil
Garlic-ginger paste, cumin, turmeric, ground coriander and garam masala
Salt, fresh coriander and lemon juice
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the tomato and cook until the oil separates from the sauce.
Add the chickpeas and a quarter cup of water and simmer 10 minutes until the sauce thickens, mashing a few chickpeas to help thicken it.
Add salt, lemon juice and coriander, and serve with the hot naan.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g and 1 tsp oil for the dough
Cooked, mashed yellow lentils 40 g
Cumin, ground coriander, red chilli and amchur for the filling
Boiled potato 150 g for the sabzi
1 small tomato and 1 small onion
Garlic-ginger paste, turmeric, salt and fresh coriander
Mix the mashed lentils with the spices for the filling.
Knead the flour with the oil and water into a firm dough, shape into small balls, roll out, place the filling in the centre and seal.
Press gently into a thick disc, arrange on a lined tray, brush with oil, and bake at 200°C for 20-22 minutes until golden.
For the sabzi: brown the onion, add the garlic-ginger paste, turmeric and tomato, then the lightly mashed potato and enough water, cook 8 minutes and serve with the kachori.

name.en: Simple Wheat and Lentil Haleem with Ghee

en: Broken wheat 40 g
Cooked yellow lentils 30 g and cooked red lentils 20 g
1 small onion
Garlic-ginger paste and turmeric
1 tsp ghee
Salt, julienned ginger and lemon to serve
Boil the broken wheat with both lentils in plenty of water until fully dissolved (25-30 minutes), whisk into a smooth porridge.
Brown the onion in the ghee until golden, add the garlic-ginger paste and turmeric and stir for a minute.
Add this mixture to the porridge and stir over low heat 5 minutes until combined.
Add salt, and serve garnished with julienned ginger and lemon juice.

name.en: Besan Chilla with Cottage Cheese and Vegetables

en: Chickpea flour (besan) 50 g
Low-fat cottage cheese, crumbled, 30 g
1 small onion, 1 small tomato and bell pepper, chopped
Cumin, turmeric and red chilli
1 tsp oil, salt and fresh coriander
About 100 ml water
Whisk the besan with water, spices and salt into a smooth batter, rest 10 minutes.
Fold in the cottage cheese, vegetables and coriander.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil, pour in half the batter and spread it into a circle, cook 3 minutes until the edges set.
Flip and cook 2 minutes more until golden, repeat with the rest, and serve hot.
170 g chicken pieces
4 tomatoes, chopped
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tbsp oil
Coriander seeds, cumin, black pepper, green chilli
Heat the oil and sear the chicken on high 5 minutes
Add the ginger-garlic paste and stir a minute
Add the tomatoes and cook until they break down and the oil separates
Add the ground spices and green chilli, cook 10 minutes

serving.en: One plate (1 cup daal + 100 g rice)

en: 70 g red lentils
100 g cooked basmati rice
1 onion and 2 tomatoes
1 tsp oil, cumin, garlic
Turmeric, chilli, coriander
Boil the lentils with turmeric and salt 20 minutes until soft
Heat the oil and fry the cumin, garlic and onion
Add the tomatoes and chilli, cook 5 minutes
Pour this tempering over the daal and serve with rice

name.en: Aloo Keema (Minced Meat and Potato) with Rice

en: Lean minced beef or lamb 120 g
Potato, cubed, 100 g
Cooked basmati rice 120 g
Puréed tomato 80 g and 1 medium onion
1 tbsp oil
Garlic-ginger paste, cumin, turmeric, ground coriander and garam masala
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the minced meat and stir until it changes colour fully and breaks apart.
Add the tomato and salt and cook 5 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the potato and a cup of water, cover and simmer 15-18 minutes until the potato is tender and the texture thickens, then serve over the rice.
Chicken breast, small pieces, 120 g
Basmati rice 110 g
1 medium onion and yogurt 60 g for the raita
2 tsp oil
Bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon, grated ginger and garlic
Grated cucumber for the raita, salt and roasted cumin for the raita
Heat the oil and toast the bay leaf, cardamom and cinnamon, then add the onion until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chicken and stir for 5 minutes until it changes colour.
Add the washed rice, one and a half cups of hot water and salt, cover and simmer 15 minutes until the water dries up and the rice is done.
Mix the yogurt with the grated cucumber, salt and roasted cumin for the raita, and serve alongside the pulao.
Lean beef, cubed, 150 g
1 tbsp toasted whole-wheat flour to thicken the broth
1 medium onion, sliced and fried
1 piece naan bread (60 g)
Garlic-ginger paste
Red chilli, ground coriander, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and nihari garam masala
Heat a spoon of oil and fry the sliced onion until golden and crisp, set aside.
In the same oil add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour, then add 3 cups of water, cover and simmer on very low heat 1.5 hours until fully tender.
Dissolve the toasted flour in a little water and stir in to thicken the broth, cook 5 minutes, and serve garnished with the fried onion and the naan.
Boiled, shredded chicken breast 120 g
Broken wheat 30 g and cooked yellow lentils 30 g
1 medium onion
Garlic-ginger paste, turmeric, ground coriander and garam masala
1 tsp oil
Julienned ginger, lemon and fresh coriander to serve
Boil the broken wheat and lentils together in plenty of water until fully dissolved into a porridge (25-30 minutes), then whisk to break it down.
Heat the oil and brown the onion, add the garlic-ginger paste and spices and stir for a minute.
Add the shredded chicken and stir until coated in the spices.
Mix the chicken into the wheat-lentil porridge over low heat for 5 minutes until combined, and serve garnished with ginger, lemon juice and coriander.
Chicken breast pieces 130 g
Basmati rice 110 g
1 medium tomato and 1 medium onion, sliced and fried
3 dried sour plums (traditional, optional)
Yogurt 60 g (half for marinating, half for the raita)
Garlic-ginger paste, biryani masala, red chilli, coriander and fresh mint
Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt, garlic-ginger paste and biryani masala for 30 minutes.
Brown the onion until golden and crisp, set half aside for garnish.
Add the marinated chicken, tomato and plums and cook 10 minutes until the chicken is done.

Boil the rice to 70 percent doneness, layer it over the chicken with mint and the fried onion, cover and cook on very low heat 15 minutes, and serve with raita (yogurt whisked with salt and roasted cumin).
Chicken breast pieces 130 g
Cooked basmati rice 100 g
Puréed tomato 100 g and 1 medium onion
Yogurt 40 g and light cream 20 g
2 tsp oil
Garlic-ginger paste, red chilli, garam masala, dried fenugreek leaves and fresh coriander
Brown the onion in the oil until golden, add the garlic-ginger paste and red chilli and stir for a minute.
Add the chicken and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato and cook until the oil separates.
Stir in the yogurt gradually over low heat so it doesn't curdle, then add half a cup of water, cover and cook 10 minutes.
Add the cream, garam masala and dried fenugreek, and cook 2 minutes, then serve over the rice garnished with coriander.
Chicken breast pieces 130 g
Cooked basmati rice 110 g
Yogurt 50 g and 1 medium onion, sliced and fried
Garlic-ginger paste
Ground coriander, red chilli, garam masala, cardamom and cinnamon
2 tsp oil and fresh coriander
Grind half the fried onion with a little water into a paste, and set the other half aside for garnish.
Heat the oil and toast the cardamom and cinnamon, add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the chicken and stir until it changes colour, then stir in the yogurt gradually over low heat.
Add the onion paste and half a cup of water, cover and cook 15 minutes until the chicken is done and the sauce thickens, then serve over the rice garnished with the fried onion and coriander.

name.en: Bhindi Gosht (Okra with Meat) with Roti

en: Beef or lamb, small cubes, 100 g
Fresh okra 150 g, sliced
2 whole-wheat roti (80 g)
1 medium onion and 1 medium tomato
Garlic-ginger paste, cumin, turmeric, ground coriander and red chilli
1 tsp oil and salt
Dry the okra thoroughly after washing and stir it in a dry pan for two minutes to drive off moisture, set aside.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the meat and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add half a cup of water, cover and simmer 20 minutes until the meat is tender, then add the okra and cook 8-10 minutes uncovered, and serve with the roti.
150 g lean minced meat
1 small onion, finely chopped and squeezed
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
Chopped coriander, mint, green chilli
Garam masala, cumin, salt
Knead the meat with all the ingredients for 3 minutes
Chill 30 minutes so the mixture firms up
Shape it around the skewers with wet hands
Grill 12 minutes, turning, until browned
150 g lean lamb
250 g fresh spinach
1 onion and 2 tomatoes
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tbsp oil, turmeric, garam masala
Brown the onion in the oil, then add the meat and the paste
Add the tomatoes, spices and a cup of water
Cover and cook 40 minutes until the meat is tender
Add the blended spinach and simmer 10 minutes
Chicken breast, cubed, 150 g
Strained yogurt 30 g and 1 tsp light cream
Garlic-ginger paste
White pepper and ground garam masala
Lemon juice and salt
1 tsp oil for grilling
Mix the yogurt with the cream, garlic-ginger paste, white pepper, garam masala, lemon juice and salt.
Coat the chicken in the mixture and chill for at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill in a 220°C oven or on a griddle pan 12-14 minutes, turning.
Brush with oil in the last two minutes until lightly charred, and serve with lemon wedges.
Potato 150 g, cubed
Fresh spinach, chopped, 100 g
1 small onion and 1 small tomato, chopped
1 tsp oil
Garlic-ginger paste, cumin, turmeric and red chilli
Salt
Heat the oil and toast the cumin, then add the onion until golden.
Add the garlic-ginger paste, turmeric and red chilli and stir for a minute.
Add the tomato, potato and salt with a quarter cup of water, cover and cook 12 minutes until the potato softens.
Add the spinach and cook 4-5 minutes uncovered until wilted, and serve hot.
Lean minced beef 150 g
1 medium onion, finely chopped, and 1 small tomato, chopped
Green chilli and chopped fresh coriander
1 tbsp cornmeal or coarsely ground rice
Ground coriander, cumin, red chilli, black pepper and amchur
1 tsp oil for cooking, and salad vegetables
Mix the minced meat with the onion, tomato, green chilli, coriander, cornmeal and spices until well combined.
Shape into relatively thick flat patties, traditionally not perfectly round.
Heat a non-stick pan with the oil and cook the patties 4-5 minutes per side over medium heat until fully done.
Serve hot with a fresh vegetable salad.

name.en: Baingan ka Salan (Aubergine in Sesame-Peanut Sauce)

en: Small aubergines 200 g
Roasted, ground peanuts and sesame seeds 20 g
Roasted desiccated coconut 10 g
1 medium onion and 1 small tomato
1 tsp oil
Garlic-ginger paste, turmeric, red chilli, ground coriander, tamarind paste and salt
Slit the aubergines from the middle while keeping them attached at the base, and lightly pan-roast until softened on the outside.
Grind the peanuts, sesame and coconut into a coarse paste.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic-ginger paste, spices and tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the nut paste, tamarind paste and a little water, then add the aubergines and cook covered 12-15 minutes over low heat until tender.
Thinly sliced beef strips 150 g
Ground fried onion 15 g
Yogurt 30 g
Garlic-ginger paste
Ground raw papaya (1 tsp) as a tenderiser, or lemon juice as an alternative
Red chilli, ground coriander, garam masala and salt, and salad vegetables
Mix the yogurt with the ground fried onion, garlic-ginger paste, ground papaya, spices and salt.
Coat the beef strips in the mixture and chill for at least 45 minutes (the papaya tenderises the fibres).
Thread onto skewers and grill in a 220°C oven or on a griddle pan 6-8 minutes, turning.
Serve hot with a fresh vegetable salad.
Bitter gourd (karela) 150 g, sliced
Beef or lamb, small cubes, 100 g
1 medium onion and 1 small tomato
Garlic-ginger paste, turmeric, ground coriander and red chilli
1 tsp oil and salt
Lemon juice
Sprinkle salt over the sliced karela and let it sit 20 minutes to reduce bitterness, then rinse and pat dry.
Brown the onion in the oil, add the garlic-ginger paste and dry spices and stir for a minute.
Add the meat and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the karela and a cup of water, cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until the meat is tender, add lemon juice before serving.

name.en: Grilled Chicken Tikka Boti with Salad

en: Chicken breast, large cubes, 160 g
Strained yogurt 40 g
Garlic-ginger paste
Kashmiri red chilli, ground cumin and garam masala
Lemon juice and salt
1 tsp oil for grilling, and salad vegetables
Mix the yogurt with the garlic-ginger paste, spices, lemon juice and salt.
Coat the chicken cubes in the mixture and chill 30-45 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill in a 220°C oven or on a griddle pan 14-16 minutes, turning, until fully cooked.
Brush with oil in the last two minutes until lightly charred, and serve with the vegetable salad.

name.en: Sarson ka Saag (Mustard Greens) with Corn Roti

en: Chopped mustard greens 150 g
Chopped spinach 60 g
Corn flour 50 g for the roti and 1 tsp oil for the dough
1 medium onion and garlic-ginger paste
1 tsp ghee and red chilli
Salt and water
Boil the mustard greens and spinach in a little water until fully tender (15-18 minutes), then mash coarsely.
Heat the ghee and brown the onion, add the garlic-ginger paste and red chilli and stir for a minute.
Add the mashed greens and salt and cook 5-7 minutes until the texture thickens.
Knead the corn flour with the oil and warm water, roll into discs and cook on a hot griddle on both sides until done, and serve with the saag.
200 g plain yogurt
Half cup cold water
Fresh mint leaves
A pinch of roasted ground cumin
A pinch of black salt
Whisk the yogurt with the water until completely smooth
Add the mint, cumin and black salt
Blend again until slightly frothy
Serve over ice with a mint leaf
150 g corn kernels
Juice of half a lemon
A pinch of chilli powder
A pinch of chaat masala and salt
Mint or coriander leaves
Boil the corn 8 minutes in salted water
Drain it and put it in a warm bowl
Add the lemon juice and spices, toss well
Garnish with mint and serve hot
Boiled and mashed potato 200 g
Boiled peas, lightly mashed, 30 g
Grated ginger and chopped green chilli
Ground cumin, garam masala, amchur and salt
1 tsp cornflour
1 tsp oil for brushing, and tamarind and mint chutney to serve
Mix the mashed potato with the peas, ginger, green chilli, spices, salt and cornflour until well combined.
Shape the mixture into small flat patties with your hands.
Arrange them on a lined tray and brush both sides with oil.
Bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp, and serve with the chutneys.
Mixed fruit, chopped (apple, banana, grapes, pomegranate) 200 g
Chaat masala and salt
Lemon juice
Roasted ground cumin (optional)
Chopped fresh mint
Cut the fruit into medium chunks in a bowl.
Sprinkle the chaat masala, salt and lemon juice over it.
Toss gently until the fruit is coated in the seasoning.
Garnish with mint and roasted cumin, and serve immediately.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g and 1 tsp oil for the dough
Boiled mashed potato 80 g and boiled peas 20 g
Cumin, ground coriander, garam masala and amchur
Green chilli and grated ginger
Salt and fresh coriander
1 tsp oil for brushing before baking
Knead the flour with the oil and a little water into a firm dough, rest 15 minutes.
Mix the potato and peas with the spices, green chilli, ginger, salt and coriander for the filling.
Roll the dough into thin discs, cut in half, shape each half into a cone, fill and seal tightly.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with oil, and bake at 200°C for 22-25 minutes until golden and crisp.
Crisp papdi wafers, 6 pieces (40 g)
Boiled potato, cubed, 50 g, and boiled chickpeas 30 g
Low-fat yogurt 60 g
Tamarind and mint chutney, 1 tsp each
Chaat masala, roasted ground cumin and red chilli
1 small onion, chopped, and fresh coriander
Arrange the papdi wafers on a serving plate.
Distribute the potato and chickpeas evenly over them.
Pour the whisked yogurt over the layer, then add the chutneys.
Sprinkle with chaat masala, roasted cumin, red chilli, onion and coriander, and serve immediately before the wafers soften.
Boiled mashed potato 100 g
Boiled carrot, peas and beans, chopped, 60 g
1 small onion, chopped, and grated ginger
Cumin, garam masala, red chilli and salt
Coarse breadcrumbs 20 g for coating
1 tsp oil for brushing
Mix the potato with the chopped vegetables, onion, ginger, spices and salt until well combined.
Shape into flat patties with your hands, then coat in the breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush both sides with oil.
Bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Lean minced beef or chicken 100 g
Boiled mashed potato 30 g to bind the mixture
1 small onion, green chilli and fresh coriander, chopped
Cumin, ground coriander, red chilli, garam masala and salt
1 whole-wheat bun (60 g)
Chutney, lettuce, sliced tomato and 1 tsp oil
Mix the minced meat with the mashed potato, onion, green chilli, coriander, spices and salt until well combined.
Shape into a flat patty the size of the bun.
Heat the oil and cook the patty 4-5 minutes per side until fully done and golden.
Lightly toast the bun, top with the patty, chutney, lettuce and tomato, and serve hot.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g and 1 tsp oil for the dough
Lean minced beef 80 g
1 small onion, chopped, and green chilli
Cumin, ground coriander, garam masala and amchur
Salt and fresh coriander
1 tsp oil for brushing before baking
Heat a dry pan and cook the minced meat with the onion and green chilli until it fully changes colour and loses its moisture.
Add the spices, salt and coriander and stir for two minutes, let the filling cool.
Knead the flour with the oil and water into a firm dough, roll into thin discs, cut in half, shape each half into a cone, fill and seal tightly.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with oil, and bake at 200°C for 22-25 minutes until golden and crisp.
Lean minced chicken 100 g
1 small onion, finely chopped, fresh coriander and green chilli
Cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, red chilli and salt
1 whole-wheat roti (45 g)
Mint chutney, sliced onion and cucumber
1 tsp oil
Mix the minced chicken with the onion, coriander, green chilli, spices and salt until well combined.
Shape the mixture around a wooden skewer or directly into log shapes with your hands.
Heat the oil and cook the skewer 8-10 minutes, turning, until fully cooked on all sides.
Warm the roti, spread with mint chutney, add the chicken with onion and cucumber, and roll it tightly.
20 g basmati rice
250 ml low-fat milk
1 tsp honey
A pinch of ground cardamom
Crushed almonds and pistachios
Soak the rice 30 minutes, then drain it
Simmer it in the milk on low heat 35 minutes, stirring
Add the honey and cardamom at the end
Serve warm or cold, topped with the nuts
12 pitted dates
20 g almonds and walnuts
1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
A pinch of cardamom
1 tsp ghee (optional)
Toast the nuts 3 minutes and chop them coarsely
Blitz the dates to a paste in a processor
Mix everything with the cardamom and ghee
Roll into balls, coat in sesame and chill

name.en: Multani Sohan Halwa with Saffron and Nuts

en: Cornflour or plain flour 30 g
Full-fat milk 150 ml
Sugar 15 g and 1 tsp ghee
Saffron strands soaked in 1 tbsp warm milk
Ground cardamom
Chopped almonds and pistachios 10 g
Dissolve the cornflour in a quarter cup of cold milk until completely lump-free.
Bring the remaining milk to a boil with the sugar, then gradually stir in the cornflour mixture, stirring constantly until it thickens.
Add the ghee, saffron and cardamom and keep stirring over low heat 5-6 minutes until it firms up and turns slightly elastic.
Pour into a greased dish in a thin layer, sprinkle the nuts and press gently, chill for an hour, and cut into diamonds.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g
1 tsp ghee for the dough and 1 tsp for brushing
Yogurt 15 g and a pinch of baking soda
Sugar 20 g and 30 ml water for a light syrup
Ground cardamom
Chopped pistachios for garnish
Knead the flour with the ghee, yogurt and baking soda into a soft firm dough, rest 15 minutes.
Shape into small, slightly flattened balls, and press a light indentation in the centre with your thumb.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with ghee, and bake at 180°C for 18-20 minutes until golden and slightly cracked.
Boil the sugar, water and cardamom for two minutes into a light syrup, dip the warm pieces briefly, and garnish with pistachios.

name.en: Baked Gulab Jamun in Light Syrup

en: Milk powder 40 g
1 tbsp whole-wheat flour
1 tbsp yogurt and a pinch of baking soda
Sugar 25 g, water 70 ml and ground cardamom for a light syrup
Saffron strands
1 tsp ghee for the dough and 1 tsp for brushing
Knead the milk powder with the flour, yogurt, baking soda and ghee into a soft, smooth, crack-free dough.
Shape into small smooth balls with no cracks, and place on a lined tray.
Brush with ghee and bake at 180°C for 15-18 minutes, turning, until golden all over.
Boil the sugar, water, cardamom and saffron for two minutes into a light syrup, and soak the warm balls in it for 10 minutes before serving.

name.en: Sheer Khurma (Vermicelli Milk Dessert with Dates)

en: Thin vermicelli 30 g
Low-fat milk 200 ml
Pitted dates, chopped, 20 g
Sugar 10 g and 1 tsp ghee
Ground cardamom and saffron strands
Chopped almonds and pistachios 8 g
Heat the ghee and toast the vermicelli over low heat 2-3 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the milk and bring to a gentle boil, then add the dates, sugar, cardamom and saffron.
Simmer 7-8 minutes until the vermicelli is cooked and the texture thickens slightly.
Pour into serving bowls and top with the nuts, and serve warm.
Fresh cheese (paneer), crumbled, 100 g
Milk powder 30 g
Low-fat milk 40 ml
Sugar 15 g
A quarter tsp ground cardamom
Chopped pistachios for garnish
Mix the crumbled cheese with the milk powder and liquid milk in a non-stick pan.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, 8-10 minutes until the mixture comes together without drying out completely.
Add the sugar and cardamom and keep stirring 3-4 minutes until it clumps.
Spread it in a greased dish about 1.5 cm thick, top with pistachios and press gently, chill for an hour, and cut into squares.

name.en: Light Rose Falooda with Basil Seeds

en: Cooked thin vermicelli 20 g
1 tsp soaked basil seeds
Low-fat milk 150 ml
Light rose syrup 2 tsp
1 tsp sugar (optional, depending on syrup sweetness)
Chopped pistachios for garnish
Boil the vermicelli until cooked, drain and rinse under cold water to prevent sticking.
Soak the basil seeds in warm water for 15 minutes until they swell.
Mix the milk with the rose syrup and sugar if using.
Layer the vermicelli and basil seeds in a glass, pour the milk over them, top with pistachios and serve cold.
Basmati rice 50 g
Sugar 25 g
Saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
Ground cardamom and a small cinnamon stick
1 tsp ghee
Almonds, pistachios and raisins 10 g
Boil the rice with the cinnamon until about 80 percent done (still firm), drain.
Heat the ghee in a pan and add the rice, sugar, saffron milk and cardamom.
Stir gently over very low heat 10 minutes until the sugar dissolves and the rice absorbs it without breaking apart.
Add the nuts and raisins, and serve warm.
2 slices whole-wheat bread (60 g)
1 tsp ghee for toasting
Low-fat milk 150 ml
Sugar 15 g, ground cardamom and saffron strands
1 tsp cornflour dissolved in a little milk
Chopped almonds and pistachios 8 g
Cut the bread slices into triangles and toast them in the ghee over medium heat on both sides until golden and crisp.
Heat the milk with the sugar, cardamom and saffron, add the dissolved cornflour and cook 5 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Arrange the bread triangles on a serving plate.
Pour the thickened milk over them, garnish with the nuts, and let it cool slightly before serving.
